items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: the people that were in that band I still play with today, like in Soulive and in Lettuce, like Eric Krasno, and so we’ve known each other for almost twenty years now.

ctx.x: Kendrink Oliver. They’re still around. Check them out. Kendrick Oliver New Life Jazz Orchestra. We started there, I was one of the original guys, and our first thing was like let’s play Count Basie charts, let’s play Duke Ellington charts, just to get the tradition. And then a faculty started writing charts for us, and then we started playing outside of the school, we started going to libraries and things around Boston. So that was how I started getting into Boston, in that big band. And what else. I played in…
Are your members spread out geographically?
